required_changes: Pin Dear ImGui ocornut/imgui v1.92.9b commit f1cc2ae15e53a861a874c3034aae6798fde194ab in deps.lock.json and resolve/materialize it through the repository dependency policy; do not follow master/docking or ad-hoc clone/vendor during builds.
Add common debug contracts and implementation: RuntimeFacade reuse seam, read-only Diagnostics snapshots, typed DebugControl/receipts, Telemetry/Trace interfaces.
Implement MutexCopySnapshotChannel as permanent reference and optionally PinnedTripleSlotSpsc behind an explicit switch; PinnedTripleSlot cannot become default without its frozen evidence.
Implement bounded DebugCommand queues with deterministic verification deadline hooks and bounded receipt retention.
Implement Debug input capture routing with per-sequence ownership latch and terminal-delivery guarantee.
Implement common C++ Dear ImGui controller/panel model and ImGuiSkiaRenderer without creating Runtime/Arc -> ImGui dependencies.
Implement all eight baseline panels with unavailable capability states where subsystems are not yet present.
Implement Telemetry rolling metrics and optional bounded Trace session arena; Trace may remain disabled by default until evidence passes.
Implement Windows embedded Debug host and host-scoped SiblingOverlay candidate, with EmbeddedComposite reference/fallback.
Implement canonical SurfaceMode PlatformDefault/CpuReference/GpuDefault debug control on the Windows reference host without encoding GDI/DXGI/SkSurface types into common APIs.
Extend existing verification/native/platform infrastructure with DUI20 cases, fault controls and evidence emitters.
Add build/reference switches and presets needed to run OFF, reference, candidate and Windows physical profiles.
forbidden_changes: Do not change canonical Document/Operation semantics for Debug UI.
Do not move product-safe Tool/Camera/Undo/Redo semantics into DebugControl.
Do not expose RuntimeScene*, SpatialIndex*, TileEntry*, SkCanvas*, SkSurface*, GPU resource pointers or HWND through Runtime public semantic APIs.
Do not make Runtime or Arc depend on Dear ImGui or SDL3.
Do not redefine Arc presenter ownership or replace current Arc semantics to make SiblingOverlay pass.
Do not treat current Arc GDI layered-window presenter as the future GPU product presenter.
Do not rebuild Skia; consume r1-full-skia-sdk.lock.json through the accepted resolver.
Do not silently fall back when a declared capability is unsupported; return Unsupported/Unavailable.
Do not delete reference/rollback paths before candidate promotion evidence is accepted.
Do not select another Dear ImGui version/commit without returning to P31 package control.
